candidates.title: Civitai prompt 146345995
candidates.prompt:
Subject: A young Western woman with a cool, pale complexion. Her hair is slicked back and parted in the center. Her face is partially obscured, revealing only her nose, mouth, and jawline, while her eyes are entirely hidden behind a "glitch art" light strip. She exudes a cold, detached, and ethereal, futuristic, cybernetic aura.
Attire: She wears a high-necked, draped, white pleated gown with a smooth, matte texture. One shoulder and arm are adorned with tiny, shimmering diamond-like sequins. The gown features diagonal cut-outs, and the right side of her body is overlaid with a vertical, glitch-effect light strip, characterized by red and blue pixelated chromatic aberration along its edges.
Mood: Serene, detached, and ethereally indifferent. Her lips are gently closed, and her expression is tranquil, carrying a mysterious, cool, and futuristic atmosphere.
Pose: Positioned in profile to the camera, her upper body held upright and still. There are no extraneous movements; the sense of fluidity in the image is created through the glitch light effects and the folds of the fabric.
Elements: Slicked-back dark hair, vertical RGB glitch-art light strips, pixelated light artifacts, a white draped pleated gown, fabric embellished with fine, sparkling sequins, a solid matte-black background, and translucent, digital, flowing light fragments.
Environment: A minimalist, enclosed, solid-black space devoid of any additional objects. The dark backdrop serves to accentuate the white gown and the vibrant, glitch-effect lighting, evoking a sense of solitary, cybernetic space.
Style: High-fashion portrait photography blended with digital "glitch art" effects—a futuristic, "quiet luxury" fashion editorial with a cool-toned, surreal, digital aesthetic.
Color Palette: Pure white (#FFFFFF), charcoal black (#000000), electric blue (#0088FF), magenta (#FF2266), and silver-gray (#C8D3DD). The composition is anchored by a dominant black-and-white base, punctuated by the contrasting red and blue pixelated chromatic aberrations. Lighting: Cool-toned, focused soft lighting. The key light illuminates the subject and the white gown from the front-side, gently accentuating the folds of the fabric and the glint of the rhinestones. The "glitch" light strips feature their own self-illuminating highlights. The background is pitch-black with no fill light, creating a sharp contrast between light and shadow.
Composition: 2:3 vertical format. The subject is centered, with a vertical "glitch" light strip on the right acting as a dividing line that draws the eye and enhances the visual depth of the frame.
Shot Type: Medium close-up; the frame extends from the top of the head to the waist/abdomen, capturing the subject’s features, the tailoring of the gown, and the placement of the glitch effects.
Tonal Palette: Dominated by low-saturation, cool-toned grays. Highlights are concentrated on the folds of the gown and the glitch effects, while the shadows are deep black. The glitch strips feature high-saturation red and blue chromatic aberration, creating a striking contrast in both temperature and luminosity.
Artistic Reference: Inspired by the futuristic fashion photography of Nick Knight, incorporating "glitch" cyber-digital art aesthetics within the context of high-end, luxury couture portraiture.
Positioned in the middle-upper section (at the 3/4 mark) is the large-font title "GTM - WOWSER" with the credit "by GTM" in smaller text in the bottom-right corner. faded80s
